```{.r .cell-code}
non_cd45_clusters <-
    c("12: Tumor",
      "16: Fibroblasts",
      "17: Endothelial cells")
metadata_T_clusters <- get_metadata_from_so(so_T, metadata = c("clusters_T"), reduction = NULL)
metadata_M_clusters <- get_metadata_from_so(so_M, metadata = c("clusters_M"), reduction = NULL)
metadata_all <- get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    mutate(clusters = ifelse(clusters == "11: Irf8-high DCs", "11: cDC1s", clusters)) %>% 
    left_join(metadata_T_clusters, by = "cell") %>% 
    left_join(metadata_M_clusters, by = "cell") %>% 
    mutate(from_subclusters = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(clusters_M) ~ as.character(clusters_M),
        !is.na(clusters_T) ~ as.character(clusters_T),
        clusters %in% c(non_cd45_clusters, "14: B cells") ~ clusters, 
        TRUE ~ "doublets"
    )) 

metadata_all <- metadata_all %>% 
    mutate(clusters = factor(clusters, levels = cluster_ID_name_ordered)) %>% 
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = rev(sort(unique(group))))) %>% 
    mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("Ctrl", "B2m KO"))) %>% 
    mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Isotype", "CD40 agonist"))) 

metadata_M <- get_metadata_from_so(so_M) %>% 
    mutate(clusters_M = factor(clusters_M, levels = cluster_M_name_ordered)) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = rev(sort(unique(group))))) %>% 
    mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("Ctrl", "B2m KO"))) %>% 
    mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Isotype", "CD40 agonist")))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
ifng_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = c("Ifng")) %>% 
    filter(!(general_T_subtypes %in% c("gdT and ILC2", "IFN-sensing"))) %>% 
    mutate(general_T_subtypes = ifelse(general_T_subtypes == "Tregs", 
                                       "CD4+ T", general_T_subtypes)) %>% 
    mutate(general_T_subtypes = ifelse(general_T_subtypes == "Proliferating", 
                                       "CD8+ T", general_T_subtypes)) %>% 
    filter(general_T_subtypes != "Naïve T") %>% 
    filter(genotype == "B2m KO") %>% 
    mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("Isotype", "CD40 agonist")))
plot_df <- ifng_df %>% 
    group_by(general_T_subtypes, mouse, group, treatment) %>% 
    summarise(mean_ifng = mean(Ifng)) %>% 
    ungroup()
dist_df <- plot_df %>% 
    group_by(treatment, general_T_subtypes) %>% 
    summarise(mean_mean_ifng = mean(mean_ifng), 
              sd_mean_ifng = sd(mean_ifng),
              se_mean_ifng = sd_mean_ifng / sqrt(n()), 
              ymin = mean_mean_ifng - se_mean_ifng, 
              ymax = mean_mean_ifng + se_mean_ifng)
t_out <- plot_df %>% 
    group_by(general_T_subtypes) %>% 
    summarise(out = broom::tidy(t.test(mean_ifng ~ treatment))) %>% 
    unnest(cols = out) %>% 
    mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>% 
    mutate_signif_levels(p_BH)
```
